messages:
maria: Quick sync request: we need an onboarding playbook for listing on AWS/GCP/Azure. Cover AMI/container artifacts, IAM/KMS, SKU mapping, trial config, and marketing assets. Who owns what?
ajit: I can do AMI/container packaging + infra checklist. Will draft naming conventions.
rachel-legal: I'll own trial T&Cs and license checks. Question: publish generic 14-day trial or allow configurable trials per marketplace?
ben-pm: Recommend 14-day self-serve, 30-day sales-assisted. I'll produce SKU -> plan -> trial CSV template.
ashley-marketing: I'll gather hero images and short descriptions. Need asset sizes (publisher portal 1024x1024, hero 1600x600).
simon-ops: Note on KMS: need clear cross-account key policy and a publisher IAM role for AMI access. I'll provide a minimal trust policy snippet.
ajit: AMI name proposal:
redwood-inference-ami-<cloud>-<region>-<model>-v<semver>-<buildid>
example: redwood-inference-ami-aws-us-west-2-gptalpha-v1.2.0-b1234
Also checklist: patching, remove dev creds, license attribution, and image scan ok.
rachel-legal: We'll need to list bundled model licenses and an encryption-at-rest assurance blurb in the listing.
ben-pm: I'll attach the CSV by EOD Wed.
ashley-marketing: I'll upload assets to s3://redwood-marketplace-assets/marketplace-1809 by Wed noon.
deploy-bot: Created PARTNERS-9199 (marketplace onboarding playbook) https://tickets.internal/redwood/PARTNERS-9199
maria: Thanks. Proposed sync Thu 11:00 PT to walk owners through deliverables and blockers. Please add pre-reads to the ticket before the meeting. :thumbsup:
